subject: Coord: Multi-cloud marketplace SKU & co-sell gating — decision plan
messages:
From: Alex Martinez <alex@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Multi-cloud listings: quick sync + decision items

Team —

We need to finalize which SKUs and region footprints we commit to for AWS, Azure, and GCP listings before we submit marketplace onboarding requests next week. Goal is to lock a consistent first-pass offering so Partner Motion can start co-sell enablement and legal can prepare the marketplace addendum.

Top-level asks for this thread:
- Confirm SKU cut (Starter / Scale / Dedicated) per cloud and whether Dedicated is GA on all clouds or limited to AWS/Azure initial wave.
- Agree on region priority by cloud (US, EU, APAC subset) and which regions require separate pricing SKU.
- Approve the co-sell gating checklist (attached) and who will own partner follow-up for each cloud.

Quick context: Skyline AI has signaled interest in Dedicated for Azure but will evaluate cost if APAC is not available. They are our pilot for co-sell on Azure.

I've attached a draft SKU catalog and a heatmap. Can each of you reply with: recommended SKU differences by cloud, one-sentence rationale, and proposed owner for cloud partner comms.

Thanks — Alex
Alex Martinez
Head of Field GTM, Redwood Inference

Attachments: 20261102-sku-catalog-draft.xlsx (spreadsheet stub), 20261102-region-priority-heatmap.png (image stub)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Nov 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Multi-cloud listings: quick sync + decision items

Alex —

My take (short):
- SKUs: Keep Starter and Scale identical across clouds. Make Dedicated a gated SKU: GA on AWS and Azure for initial launch, GCP in wave 2. Rationale: Dedicated requires tested autoscaling and GGK (GCP GPU) validation which is still in infra roadmap.
- Regions: US + EU core for all SKUs. APAC: enable for Starter/Scale in select regions (ap-northeast1, asia-southeast1) but Dedicated only by request/PO until we prove telemetry.
- Co-sell owner: I will own AWS and Azure partner leads; Soojin to own GCP communication and final listing checklist with Marcus.

Operational notes for Partner Motion: we should not publish Dedicated pricing publicly for GCP to avoid confusion; mark as "contact sales" on listing. Also recommend a one-month pilot discount for Skyline AI and flag for legal to pre-approve via addendum.

-Karthik
Director, Sales Engineering

On Mon, Nov 2, 2026 at 09:12 AM Alex Martinez <alex@redwood.com> wrote:
> Team —
> ...

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Nov 2026 13:40:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Multi-cloud listings: quick sync + decision items

Agree with Karthik and adding a couple operational constraints from Marketplace ops side:

- AWS: We can push Starter/Scale/Dedicated in the same listing (three SKUs) and enable Co-sell badge as long as we have the Marketplace listing + AWS MOU signed. Dedicated will require a separate AMI/test image and EULA flag in the listing. Estimated time to live: 10 business days after legal signs.
- Azure: Listing supports Plans and SKUs; recommend mapping our Starter->Plan A, Scale->Plan B, Dedicated->Plan C. For Skyline AI specifically, request a private plan (preview) tied to their tenant id so pricing can be negotiated.
- GCP: Two-step: publish Starter/Scale first; Dedicated afterwards. GCP requires a partner verification call and a validated infra test report (quantized model numbers, perf).

I'll own the marketplace listing submission for AWS and Azure. Soojin: can you confirm GCP test timeline?

Marcus
Marketplace Programs Manager

Attachments: 20261102-co-sell-gating-checklist.pdf (doc stub)

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 03 Nov 2026 10:14:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Multi-cloud listings: quick sync + decision items

Quick update on GCP validation:
- Infra has scheduled the GCP perf validation for Nov 10-12 (quantized LLM tests + 1M token soak). If results are green we can submit Dedicated within 4 business days after test sign-off.
- Recommendation: publish Starter/Scale on GCP on Nov 16 and hold Dedicated until Nov 22 (internal ETA).
- I'll coordinate with Marcus for the listing text and with Karthik on the "contact sales" flow for Dedicated.

One operational ask: we need an explicit support SLA called out in the listing for Dedicated customers (even if time-limited during pilot). Marcus, can you add a 72-hour response SLA in the gating checklist?

Soojin
Head of Cloud Partnerships

From: Nina Patel <nina.patel@amazon.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: AWS Marketplace Partners <aws-marketplace-partners@amazon.com>
Date: Wed, 04 Nov 2026 09:03:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Multi-cloud listings: quick sync + decision items

Hi Alex / team —

Thanks for the heads up. A few notes from AWS side:
- Co-sell: we can initiate co-sell once the listing is live and the AWS GTM brief is completed. Please share the short one-pager for our co-sell kickoff by EOD Nov 6.
- Dedicated SKU: AWS will accept Dedicated as a separate AMI-based product. For the co-sell badge we need a partner business plan + estimated ARR.
- Regions: if you prioritize ap-southeast-2 (Sydney) we can route a partner rep to support the APAC pilot.

I'll loop in our Partner Sales rep for Skyline AI after you publish the listing.

Regards,
Nina Patel
Sr. Partner Manager, AWS Marketplace

On Tue, Nov 3, 2026 at 10:14 AM Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com> wrote:
> Quick update on GCP validation:...

From: Alex Martinez <alex@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Nina Patel <nina.patel@amazon.com>
Date: Thu, 05 Nov 2026 16:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Multi-cloud listings: quick sync + decision items

Team / Nina —

Thanks all for the quick feedback. Summary and decisions:
- SKUs: Starter, Scale — publish across AWS/Azure/GCP simultaneously. Dedicated — AWS + Azure initial launch; GCP held for wave 2 pending perf sign-off (Soojin to confirm dates).
- Regions: US + EU for all SKUs. APAC: include Starter/Scale in ap-northeast1 and ap-southeast1; open Dedicated in APAC only by pilot request. Marcus to mark Dedicated as "contact sales" on GCP listing.
- Ownership: Marcus will submit AWS/Azure listings (ETA Nov 9). Soojin to coordinate GCP perf tests and submit Dedicated listing post validation. Karthik will run co-sell kickoff docs and own partner briefing for Skyline AI.
- Action items: Marcus to upload final listing drafts to Drive (link below) by EOD Nov 6; Karthik to share co-sell one-pager; Soojin to confirm GCP test sign-off date.

I'll run the partner kickoff once all artifacts are in Drive and Nina, please confirm once your team receives the one-pager.

Alex
Head of Field GTM, Redwood Inference
